lines: Behind them, the army of Pharaoh. In front of them, the sea.
Thousands of people, with nowhere left to run. And they cried out: "We are going to be overtaken!"
But one man did not panic. Musa, alayhis salaam, said: "No! Indeed, with me is my Lord. He will guide me."
How did a baby who was meant to be killed... end up standing here, between a tyrant and the sea?
This is the story of Prophet Musa, alayhis salaam, the prophet the Quran speaks of more than any other.
From the river... to the sea.
